{{Top|leg}}
The '''Moff's Palace''' was a newly constructed building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Derilysa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. It was the residence of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ruler of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].
